_note: Private gateway (this worktree, Claude as the model, REGISTRY_SEED_ENV=false, AVATAR_PREWARM_ON_CASE_START=true) and Lambda gpu_1x_a100_sxm4 (40 GB) workers it launched, 2026-10-22. Browser: Playwright Chromium with no proxy; TURN over TCP through scripts/turn_ws_tunnel.py (TURN over TLS on 443 could not be carried from this sandbox: Chromium's WebRTC resolves the TURN name with its own DNS, ignoring /etc/hosts and --host-resolver-rules, and the sandbox re-terminates outbound TLS). Voice click at case open (the worst case for the call's portrait) unless noted. Speech start = question sent to first audible patient sample in the page. Lip lag: positive = mouth after the voice; meter offsets with a score under 0.3 are not counted. probe_lag_ms: the runner's sync probe (corner block carrying each frame's audio loudness), end to end and independent of the portrait. Sender skew = video minus audio send-time offset measured by the runner per encoded frame.

tr-a100-final-run2: same worker, second case (warm runner); line 1 waited for history.presenting (stall line); the meter could not lock on this portrait either
tr-a100-final-run3: sync probe on: line 1 -360 ms from following a transient 400 ms video sender lag second by second (fixed with the 20 s 10th-percentile window)
tr-a100-final-run4: 20 s 10th-percentile window, probe in the loop after each line: probe -240 ms on line 1 (receive side converging), then +120, +80, +40, +80, +40 ms
tr-a100-final-run5: final runner code, corrections during the line; first case on a fresh runner. Line 4 ran under 300 ms of network jitter: the probe scored 0.36 and the tile fell back to the face meter (0.27, -400 ms), which moved the bias the wrong way and line 5 opened 320 ms late until two corrections brought it to 0 (the fallback is removed: with the probe on, a weak probe reading sends nothing)
tr-a100-final-run6: same worker, second case, with the tile fix: whole-line probe 0, +40, 0, -80, +40, +40 ms; after corrections +40, +40 ms
tr-h100-final-run1: H100 PCIe 80 GB, us-west-3, first case: runner on time (32 to 35 fps, skew -6 to -12 ms) but 400 to 740 ms jitter buffers on the sandbox path; probe readings swing, several under score 0.5; Chatterbox T3 35 ms a token on the default window
tr-h100-final-run2: same worker, second case, fast-start window set by /acudx/tuning: first chunk 0.78 to 1.42 s; probe -400 to +240 ms at line starts, the last two lines +40 and 0 ms
